title: Edge Cases and Practices
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the business_requirement path (FR-037, AI §9.1). Generated against the Stage 6 architecture and the context set.

EVERY EDGE CASE AND EVERY PRACTICE NAMES THE PART OF THE DESIGN IT CONCERNS. FR-037: generic advice not tied to the submitted design is a defect. The pipeline refuses an edge case or a practice naming a component the architecture neither has nor integrates.

An edge case is a concrete scenario with its consequence and how the design handles it (or should). A practice is a specific, applicable practice with the component it applies to and why.

component.description: The architecture component, or the external system a component names, the scenario arises in.

scenario.description: A concrete situation, in terms of this design's inputs, volumes or systems.

consequence.description: What happens if it is not handled.

handling.description: What the design does about it, or what it should do.

practices.description: May be empty: a practice is listed only when it applies to a specific part of this design.

applies_to.description: The component or integration the practice applies to.

rationale.description: Why it applies here, in terms of this design.
